title: Safeguard Sanctions Dataset Entry
description: One normalized sanctions record as produced by a source adapter. Safeguard is not an official sanctions-data provider: external datasets enter through adapters that convert source records into this deterministic shape, which registries and the policy engine can consume. Records are keyed by a 32-byte subject hash so no personal data is stored on-chain.

subject_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the subject identifier as normalized by the adapter; 32 bytes matching the on-chain id width.

list_id.description: Identifier of the source list, e.g. "OFAC-SDN".

status.description: Whether the record is currently in force.

dataset_version.description: Monotonic version of the dataset this record belongs to; lets the registry detect stale data.

effective_at.description: RFC 3339 time the listing became effective.

source.description: Source identifier (adapter/authority), e.g. "ofac". Free-form so new providers do not require a schema change.
